struct Closure
    parameter::String
    body::MLNode
    environment::Dict{String,Any}
end
struct Builtin
    behavior::Function
end
struct RuntimeFailure <: Exception
    position::MLPosition
    message::String
end
function checked_integer(value,position)
    -2147483648 <= value <= 2147483647 || throw(RuntimeFailure(position,"integer overflow"))
    value
end
function compare_values(first,second,position)
    first isa Union{Closure,Builtin} && throw(RuntimeFailure(position,"functional value compared"))
    if first isa Tuple || first isa AbstractVector
        for (left,right) in zip(first,second)
            order = compare_values(left,right,position)
            order == 0 || return order
        end
        return Int(length(first) > length(second))-Int(length(first) < length(second))
    end
    Int(first > second)-Int(first < second)
end
function binary_operation(operator,first,second,position)
    operator == "+" && return checked_integer(first+second,position)
    operator == "-" && return checked_integer(first-second,position)
    operator == "*" && return checked_integer(first*second,position)
    if operator in ("/","mod")
        second == 0 && throw(RuntimeFailure(position,"division by zero"))
        quotient = div(first,second)
        return operator == "/" ? checked_integer(quotient,position) : first-second*quotient
    end
    operator == "^" && return first * second
    operator == "::" && return [Any[first];second]
    order = compare_values(first,second,position)
    operator == "=" && return order == 0
    operator == "<>" && return order != 0
    operator == "<" && return order < 0
    operator == ">" && return order > 0
    operator == "<=" ? order <= 0 : order >= 0
end
function match_pattern!(pattern,value,bindings)
    kind = pattern.kind
    kind == "wildcard" && return true
    if kind == "name"
        bindings[pattern.value] = value
        return true
    elseif kind in ("integer","boolean","string")
        return pattern.value == value
    elseif kind == "cons"
        return !isempty(value) && match_pattern!(pattern.children[1],value[1],bindings) && match_pattern!(pattern.children[2],value[2:end],bindings)
    elseif kind == "list" && length(value) != length(pattern.children)
        return false
    end
    all(match_pattern!(child,item,bindings) for (child,item) in zip(pattern.children,value))
end
mutable struct Evaluator
    calls::Int
end
Evaluator() = Evaluator(0)
function evaluate!(evaluator,expression,environment)
    kind,children = expression.kind,expression.children
    kind in ("integer","boolean","string") && return expression.value
    kind == "name" && return environment[expression.value]
    kind == "fun" && return Closure(expression.value.spelling,children[1],copy(environment))
    if kind == "apply"
        function_value = evaluate!(evaluator,children[1],environment)
        argument = evaluate!(evaluator,children[2],environment)
        evaluator.calls += 1
        function_value isa Builtin && return function_value.behavior(argument,expression.position)
        inner = copy(function_value.environment)
        function_value.parameter == "_" || (inner[function_value.parameter] = argument)
        return evaluate!(evaluator,function_value.body,inner)
    elseif kind == "binary"
        first = evaluate!(evaluator,children[1],environment)
        operator = expression.value.spelling
        operator == "&&" && return first ? evaluate!(evaluator,children[2],environment) : false
        operator == "||" && return first ? true : evaluate!(evaluator,children[2],environment)
        second = evaluate!(evaluator,children[2],environment)
        return binary_operation(operator,first,second,expression.value.position)
    elseif kind == "negate"
        return checked_integer(-evaluate!(evaluator,children[1],environment),expression.value.position)
    elseif kind == "if"
        selected = evaluate!(evaluator,children[1],environment) ? children[2] : children[3]
        return evaluate!(evaluator,selected,environment)
    elseif kind == "pair"
        first = evaluate!(evaluator,children[1],environment)
        second = evaluate!(evaluator,children[2],environment)
        return first,second
    elseif kind == "list"
        return Any[evaluate!(evaluator,child,environment) for child in children]
    elseif kind == "match"
        value = evaluate!(evaluator,children[1],environment)
        for (pattern,arm) in expression.value
            bindings = Dict{String,Any}()
            if match_pattern!(pattern,value,bindings)
                return evaluate!(evaluator,arm,merge(environment,bindings))
            end
        end
        throw(RuntimeFailure(expression.position,"match failure"))
    end
    evaluate!(evaluator,children[1],evaluate_group!(evaluator,expression.value,environment))
end
function evaluate_group!(evaluator,group,environment)
    result = copy(environment)
    if group.rec_position !== nothing
        for binding in group.bindings
            expression = binding.expression
            result[binding.name] = Closure(expression.value.spelling,expression.children[1],result)
        end
    else
        values = Any[evaluate!(evaluator,binding.expression,environment) for binding in group.bindings]
        for (binding,value) in zip(group.bindings,values)
            result[binding.name] = value
        end
    end
    result
end

struct InferenceError <: Exception
    kind::String
    position::MLPosition
    details::NamedTuple
end
inference_error(kind,position;details...) = throw(InferenceError(kind,position,(;details...)))
mutable struct Inferencer
    local_bindings::Vector{Binding}
end
Inferencer() = Inferencer(Binding[])
function check_type!(expected,found,position)
    try
        unify!(expected,found)
    catch failure
        failure isa UnificationFailure || rethrow()
        inference_error("check",position;expected,found,failure)
    end
end
function operator_types(operator)
    operator in ("+","-","*","/","mod") && return (INT,INT,INT)
    operator == "^" && return (STRING,STRING,STRING)
    operator in ("&&","||") && return (BOOL,BOOL,BOOL)
    variable = TypeVariable()
    if operator == "::"
        sequence = ml_type("list",variable)
        return variable,sequence,sequence
    end
    variable,variable,BOOL
end
function infer_expression!(inferencer,expression,environment)
    kind,children = expression.kind,expression.children
    if kind in ("integer","boolean","string")
        result = Dict("integer"=>INT,"boolean"=>BOOL,"string"=>STRING)[kind]
    elseif kind == "name"
        haskey(environment,expression.value) || inference_error("unbound",expression.position;name=expression.value,candidates=collect(keys(environment)))
        result = instantiate(environment[expression.value])
    elseif kind == "fun"
        argument = TypeVariable()
        inner = copy(environment)
        expression.value.spelling == "_" || (inner[expression.value.spelling] = Scheme(argument))
        result = ml_type("function",argument,infer_expression!(inferencer,children[1],inner))
    elseif kind == "apply"
        function_type = resolve_type(infer_expression!(inferencer,children[1],environment))
        if function_type isa TypeVariable
            argument,result = TypeVariable(),TypeVariable()
            function_type.binding = ml_type("function",argument,result)
        elseif function_type.kind == "function"
            argument,result = function_type.children
        else
            inference_error("not_function",children[1].position;found=function_type)
        end
        found = infer_expression!(inferencer,children[2],environment)
        check_type!(argument,found,children[2].position)
    elseif kind == "binary"
        first,second,result = operator_types(expression.value.spelling)
        check_type!(first,infer_expression!(inferencer,children[1],environment),children[1].position)
        check_type!(second,infer_expression!(inferencer,children[2],environment),children[2].position)
    elseif kind == "negate"
        check_type!(INT,infer_expression!(inferencer,children[1],environment),children[1].position)
        result = INT
    elseif kind == "if"
        check_type!(BOOL,infer_expression!(inferencer,children[1],environment),children[1].position)
        result = infer_expression!(inferencer,children[2],environment)
        found = infer_expression!(inferencer,children[3],environment)
        check_type!(result,found,children[3].position)
    elseif kind == "pair"
        first = infer_expression!(inferencer,children[1],environment)
        second = infer_expression!(inferencer,children[2],environment)
        result = ml_type("pair",first,second)
    elseif kind == "list"
        element = TypeVariable()
        for child in children
            check_type!(element,infer_expression!(inferencer,child,environment),child.position)
        end
        result = ml_type("list",element)
    elseif kind == "match"
        matched = infer_expression!(inferencer,children[1],environment)
        result = TypeVariable()
        for (pattern,arm) in expression.value
            bindings = Dict{String,MLType}()
            pattern_type = infer_pattern!(pattern,bindings)
            check_type!(matched,pattern_type,pattern.position)
            inner = copy(environment)
            for (name,value) in bindings
                inner[name] = Scheme(value)
            end
            check_type!(result,infer_expression!(inferencer,arm,inner),arm.position)
        end
    else
        inner = infer_group!(inferencer,expression.value,environment;local_group=true)
        result = infer_expression!(inferencer,children[1],inner)
    end
    expression.inferred = result
    result
end
function infer_pattern!(pattern,bindings)
    kind,children = pattern.kind,pattern.children
    kind == "wildcard" && return TypeVariable()
    if kind == "name"
        haskey(bindings,pattern.value) && inference_error("duplicate_pattern",pattern.position;name=pattern.value)
        result = TypeVariable()
        bindings[pattern.value] = result
        return result
    elseif kind in ("integer","boolean","string")
        return Dict("integer"=>INT,"boolean"=>BOOL,"string"=>STRING)[kind]
    elseif kind == "pair"
        first = infer_pattern!(children[1],bindings)
        second = infer_pattern!(children[2],bindings)
        return ml_type("pair",first,second)
    end
    element = TypeVariable()
    sequence = ml_type("list",element)
    if kind == "cons"
        check_type!(element,infer_pattern!(children[1],bindings),children[1].position)
        check_type!(sequence,infer_pattern!(children[2],bindings),children[2].position)
    else
        for child in children
            check_type!(element,infer_pattern!(child,bindings),child.position)
        end
    end
    sequence
end
function infer_group!(inferencer,group,environment;local_group=false)
    names = Set{String}()
    for binding in group.bindings
        binding.name in names && inference_error("duplicate_let",binding.position;name=binding.name)
        push!(names,binding.name)
        group.rec_position !== nothing && binding.expression.kind != "fun" && inference_error("recursive_function",binding.position;name=binding.name)
    end
    if group.rec_position === nothing
        inferred = MLType[infer_expression!(inferencer,binding.expression,environment) for binding in group.bindings]
    else
        inferred = MLType[TypeVariable() for _ in group.bindings]
        recursive = copy(environment)
        for (binding,value) in zip(group.bindings,inferred)
            recursive[binding.name] = Scheme(value)
        end
        for (binding,expected) in zip(group.bindings,inferred)
            found = infer_expression!(inferencer,binding.expression,recursive)
            check_type!(expected,found,binding.position)
        end
    end
    result = copy(environment)
    for (binding,value) in zip(group.bindings,inferred)
        binding.scheme = generalize(value,environment)
        result[binding.name] = binding.scheme
    end
    local_group && append!(inferencer.local_bindings,group.bindings)
    result
end

const MLPosition = Tuple{String,Int,Int}
const KEYWORDS = Set(split("let rec and in fun if then else match with true false mod val"))
const SYMBOLS = Set(split(";; -> :: : || && <= >= <> ; = < > + - * / ^ ( ) [ ] , |"))
const ESCAPES = Dict('n'=>'\n','t'=>'\t','\\'=>'\\','"'=>'"')
struct MLToken
    kind::String
    spelling::String
    value::Any
    position::MLPosition
end
is_name(token) = token.kind == "identifier" && token.spelling != "_"
letter(c) = 'A' <= c <= 'Z' || 'a' <= c <= 'z'
word_character(c) = letter(c) || '0' <= c <= '9' || c == '_'
ml_character(source,index) = 1 <= index <= length(source) ? source[index] : '\0'
function tokenize(source,filename)
    tokens = MLToken[]
    index,line,column = 1,1,1
    while index <= length(source)
        start = index
        position = (filename,line,column)
        character = source[index]
        kind,value = nothing,nothing
        pair = source[index:min(index+1,length(source))]
        if character in (' ','\n')
            index += 1
        elseif pair == "(*"
            closing = findnext("*)",source,index+2)
            if closing === nothing
                kind,value = "invalid","unterminated comment"
                index = length(source)+1
            else
                index = closing.stop+1
            end
        elseif '0' <= character <= '9'
            index += 1
            while '0' <= ml_character(source,index) <= '9'
                index += 1
            end
            digits = lstrip(c -> c == '0',source[start:index-1])
            isempty(digits) && (digits = "0")
            if length(digits) > 10 || (length(digits) == 10 && digits > "2147483647")
                kind,value = "invalid","integer literal too large"
            else
                kind,value = "integer",parse(Int64,digits)
            end
        elseif letter(character) || character == '_'
            index += 1
            while word_character(ml_character(source,index)) || ml_character(source,index) == '\''
                index += 1
            end
            value = String(source[start:index-1])
            kind = value in KEYWORDS ? value : "identifier"
        elseif character == '\'' && 'a' <= ml_character(source,index+1) <= 'z'
            index += 2
            while word_character(ml_character(source,index))
                index += 1
            end
            kind,value = "type_variable",String(source[start:index-1])
        elseif character == '"'
            index += 1
            decoded = IOBuffer()
            invalid_escape = false
            while index <= length(source) && !(source[index] in ('"','\n'))
                if source[index] == '\\' && index < length(source) && source[index+1] != '\n'
                    escape = source[index+1]
                    if haskey(ESCAPES,escape)
                        print(decoded,ESCAPES[escape])
                    else
                        invalid_escape = true
                    end
                    index += 2
                else
                    print(decoded,source[index])
                    index += 1
                end
            end
            if index > length(source) || source[index] == '\n'
                kind,value = "invalid","unterminated string"
            else
                index += 1
                kind,value = invalid_escape ? ("invalid","invalid escape sequence") : ("string",String(take!(decoded)))
            end
        elseif pair in SYMBOLS
            index += 2
            kind,value = String(pair),String(pair)
        elseif string(character) in SYMBOLS
            index += 1
            kind,value = string(character),string(character)
        else
            index += 1
            kind,value = "invalid","illegal character '$character'"
        end
        consumed = source[start:index-1]
        kind === nothing || push!(tokens,MLToken(kind,consumed,value,position))
        newlines = count(==('\n'),consumed)
        if newlines > 0
            line += newlines
            column = length(consumed)-findlast(==('\n'),consumed)+1
        else
            column += length(consumed)
        end
    end
    push!(tokens,MLToken("EOF","",nothing,(filename,count(==('\n'),source)+1,1)))
    tokens
end

include("lexer.jl")
include("unifier.jl")
include("parser.jl")
include("inference.jl")
include("evaluator.jl")
function print_value(value)
    value isa Bool && return value ? "true" : "false"
    value isa Integer && return string(value)
    if value isa String
        escaped = replace(value,"\\"=>"\\\\","\""=>"\\\"","\n"=>"\\n","\t"=>"\\t")
        return "\"" * escaped * "\""
    elseif value isa Tuple
        return "(" * print_value(value[1]) * ", " * print_value(value[2]) * ")"
    elseif value isa AbstractVector
        return "[" * join(print_value.(value),"; ") * "]"
    end
    "<fun>"
end
mutable struct TypePrinter
    names::IdDict{TypeVariable,String}
    quantified::Union{Nothing,Set{TypeVariable}}
end
TypePrinter(quantified=nothing) = TypePrinter(IdDict{TypeVariable,String}(),quantified)
function print_type!(printer,value)
    value = resolve_type(value)
    if value isa TypeVariable
        if !haskey(printer.names,value)
            index = length(printer.names)
            prefix = printer.quantified !== nothing && !(value in printer.quantified) ? "'_" : "'"
            suffix = index >= 26 ? string(index ÷ 26) : ""
            printer.names[value] = prefix * string(Char(Int('a')+index%26)) * suffix
        end
        return printer.names[value]
    end
    value.kind in ("int","bool","string") && return value.kind
    first = resolve_type(value.children[1])
    left = print_type!(printer,first)
    first_kind = first isa TypeVariable ? "" : first.kind
    if value.kind == "list"
        first_kind in ("pair","function") && (left = "(" * left * ")")
        return left * " list"
    end
    second = resolve_type(value.children[2])
    right = print_type!(printer,second)
    second_kind = second isa TypeVariable ? "" : second.kind
    if value.kind == "pair"
        first_kind in ("pair","function") && (left = "(" * left * ")")
        second_kind in ("pair","function") && (right = "(" * right * ")")
        return left * " * " * right
    end
    first_kind == "function" && (left = "(" * left * ")")
    left * " -> " * right
end
function format_declared_type(expression)
    expression.kind == "type_variable" && return expression.value
    expression.kind in ("int","bool","string") && return expression.kind
    first = expression.children[1]
    left = format_declared_type(first)
    if expression.kind == "list"
        first.kind in ("pair","function") && (left = "(" * left * ")")
        return left * " list"
    end
    second = expression.children[2]
    right = format_declared_type(second)
    if expression.kind == "pair"
        first.kind in ("pair","function") && (left = "(" * left * ")")
        second.kind in ("pair","function") && (right = "(" * right * ")")
        return left * " * " * right
    end
    first.kind == "function" && (left = "(" * left * ")")
    left * " -> " * right
end
function signature_type(expression,variables)
    if expression.kind == "type_variable"
        return get!(() -> TypeVariable(),variables,expression.value)
    end
    ml_type(expression.kind,[signature_type(child,variables) for child in expression.children]...)
end
function identical_types(first,second)
    first,second = resolve_type(first),resolve_type(second)
    (first isa TypeVariable || second isa TypeVariable) && return first === second
    first.kind == second.kind && all(identical_types(a,b) for (a,b) in zip(first.children,second.children))
end
function signature_matches(inferred,declared,assignments)
    inferred,declared = resolve_type(inferred),resolve_type(declared)
    if inferred isa TypeVariable
        haskey(assignments,inferred) && return identical_types(assignments[inferred],declared)
        assignments[inferred] = declared
        return true
    end
    (declared isa TypeVariable || inferred.kind != declared.kind) && return false
    all(signature_matches(first,second,assignments) for (first,second) in zip(inferred.children,declared.children))
end
function check_signatures!(group,signatures)
    for (binding,signature) in zip(group.bindings,signatures)
        signature === nothing && continue
        declared = signature_type(signature[2],Dict{String,TypeVariable}())
        inferred = binding.scheme.value
        signature_matches(inferred,declared,IdDict{TypeVariable,MLType}()) || inference_error("signature",binding.position;name=binding.name,inferred,declared)
        binding.scheme = Scheme(declared,free_variables(declared))
    end
end
function edit_distance(first,second)
    previous = collect(0:length(second))
    for (row,left) in enumerate(first)
        current = [row]
        for (column,right) in enumerate(second)
            push!(current,min(current[end]+1,previous[column+1]+1,previous[column]+Int(left != right)))
        end
        previous = current
    end
    previous[end]
end
function name_candidate(name,candidates)
    choices = Tuple{Int,String}[]
    for candidate in candidates
        distance = edit_distance(name,candidate)
        distance <= 2 && distance < length(name) && push!(choices,(distance,candidate))
    end
    isempty(choices) ? nothing : minimum(choices)[2]
end
function type_error_message(error)
    details,printer = error.details,TypePrinter()
    if error.kind == "unbound"
        message = "unbound variable '$(details.name)'"
        candidate = name_candidate(details.name,details.candidates)
        candidate === nothing ? message : message * " (did you mean '$candidate'?)"
    elseif error.kind == "not_function"
        "expected a function but found " * print_type!(printer,details.found)
    elseif error.kind == "check"
        message = "expected " * print_type!(printer,details.expected) * " but found " * print_type!(printer,details.found)
        failure = details.failure
        if failure.infinite
            variable,value = failure.expected,failure.found
            variable isa TypeVariable || ((variable,value) = (value,variable))
            message *= " (infinite type " * print_type!(printer,variable) * " = " * print_type!(printer,value) * ")"
        elseif failure.nested
            message *= " (" * print_type!(printer,failure.expected) * " vs " * print_type!(printer,failure.found) * ")"
        end
        message
    elseif error.kind == "duplicate_pattern"
        "variable '$(details.name)' is bound twice in this pattern"
    elseif error.kind == "duplicate_let"
        "variable '$(details.name)' is bound twice in this let"
    elseif error.kind == "recursive_function"
        "'$(details.name)' in let rec must be a function"
    else
        "'$(details.name)' has type " * print_type!(printer,details.inferred) * " but its signature is " * print_type!(printer,details.declared)
    end
end
function built_in_environments()
    first,second = TypeVariable(),TypeVariable()
    fst_scheme = Scheme(ml_type("function",ml_type("pair",first,second),first),Set([first,second]))
    first,second = TypeVariable(),TypeVariable()
    snd_scheme = Scheme(ml_type("function",ml_type("pair",first,second),second),Set([first,second]))
    result = TypeVariable()
    types = Dict("fst"=>fst_scheme,"snd"=>snd_scheme,"not"=>Scheme(ml_type("function",BOOL,BOOL)),
        "string_of_int"=>Scheme(ml_type("function",INT,STRING)),"failwith"=>Scheme(ml_type("function",STRING,result),Set([result])))
    values = Dict{String,Any}("fst"=>Builtin((value,position) -> value[1]),"snd"=>Builtin((value,position) -> value[2]),
        "not"=>Builtin((value,position) -> !value),"string_of_int"=>Builtin((value,position) -> string(value)),
        "failwith"=>Builtin((value,position) -> throw(RuntimeFailure(position,"failure " * print_value(value)))))
    types,values
end
function leading_parameters(expression)
    parameters = String[]
    while expression.kind == "fun"
        push!(parameters,expression.value.spelling)
        expression = expression.children[1]
    end
    parameters,expression
end
function format_binding(binding)
    parameters,body = leading_parameters(binding.expression)
    join([binding.name;parameters;"=";format_expression(body)]," ")
end
format_group(group) = (group.rec_position === nothing ? "let " : "let rec ") * join(format_binding.(group.bindings)," and ")
function ends_with_match(expression)
    expression.kind == "match" && return true
    expression.kind in ("let","fun") && return ends_with_match(expression.children[1])
    expression.kind == "if" && return ends_with_match(expression.children[3])
    false
end
function format_pattern(pattern)
    kind = pattern.kind
    kind in ("wildcard","name") && return pattern.value
    kind in ("integer","boolean","string") && return print_value(pattern.value)
    kind == "list" && return "[" * join(format_pattern.(pattern.children),"; ") * "]"
    first,second = pattern.children
    left,right = format_pattern(first),format_pattern(second)
    kind == "pair" && return "(" * left * ", " * right * ")"
    first.kind == "cons" && (left = "(" * left * ")")
    left * " :: " * right
end
function format_expression(expression,minimum=0)
    kind,children = expression.kind,expression.children
    strength = 9
    if kind in ("integer","boolean","string")
        text = print_value(expression.value)
    elseif kind == "name"
        text = expression.value
    elseif kind == "fun"
        strength = 0
        parameters,body = leading_parameters(expression)
        text = "fun " * join(parameters," ") * " -> " * format_expression(body)
    elseif kind == "apply"
        strength = 8
        text = format_expression(children[1],8) * " " * format_expression(children[2],9)
    elseif kind == "binary"
        operator = expression.value.spelling
        strength,right_associative = OPERATORS[operator]
        text = format_expression(children[1],strength+Int(right_associative)) * " " * operator * " " * format_expression(children[2],strength+Int(!right_associative))
    elseif kind == "negate"
        strength = 7
        text = "-" * format_expression(children[1],7)
    elseif kind == "if"
        strength = 0
        text = "if " * format_expression(children[1]) * " then " * format_expression(children[2]) * " else " * format_expression(children[3])
    elseif kind == "pair"
        text = "(" * format_expression(children[1]) * ", " * format_expression(children[2]) * ")"
    elseif kind == "list"
        text = "[" * join(format_expression.(children),"; ") * "]"
    elseif kind == "let"
        strength = 0
        text = format_group(expression.value) * " in " * format_expression(children[1])
    else
        strength = 0
        arms = String[]

const FILE_NAMES = ("prelude.ml","program.ml")
const COUNTER_NAMES = ("items","bindings","syntax","type","runtime","warnings","calls")
mutable struct MLRunner

    type_environment::Dict{String,Scheme}
    value_environment::Dict{String,Any}
    current_file::String
    statistics::Dict{String,Dict{String,Int}}
    reports::Vector{String}
    types::Vector{String}
    values::Vector{String}
    formatted::Vector{String}
end
function report!(runner,kind,position,message)
    filename,line,column = position
    counter = kind == "warning" ? "warnings" : split(kind)[1]
    runner.statistics[runner.current_file][counter] += 1
    push!(runner.reports,"$filename:$line:$column: $kind: $message")
    source_lines = runner.sources[filename]
    if line <= length(source_lines)
        push!(runner.reports,"    " * source_lines[line])
        push!(runner.reports,repeat(" ",column+3) * "^")
    end
end
function unused_signature!(runner,signature)
    name = signature[1]

end
function write_types!(runner,item,inferred,local_bindings)
    if item.kind == "declaration"
        for binding in item.value.bindings
            push!(runner.types,binding.name * " : " * print_type!(TypePrinter(),binding.scheme.value) * classification_suffix(binding))
        end
    else
        push!(runner.types,"- : " * print_type!(TypePrinter(),inferred))
    end
    for binding in sort(local_bindings;by=b -> b.position[2:3])
        filename,line,column = binding.position
        text = "  $(binding.name) ($line:$column) : " * print_type!(TypePrinter(binding.scheme.quantified),binding.scheme.value)
        push!(runner.types,text * classification_suffix(binding))
    end
end
function process_item!(runner,item,pending,evaluator,counts)
    push!(runner.formatted,format_item(item))
    if item.kind == "signature"
        name = item.value[1].spelling
        haskey(pending,name) && unused_signature!(runner,pending[name])
        pending[name] = item.value
        return
    end
    signatures = item.kind == "declaration" ? [pop!(pending,binding.name,nothing) for binding in item.value.bindings] : Any[]
    inferencer,inferred = Inferencer(),nothing
    try
        if item.kind == "declaration"
            infer_group!(inferencer,item.value,runner.type_environment)
            check_signatures!(item.value,signatures)
        else
            inferred = infer_expression!(inferencer,item.value,runner.type_environment)
        end
    catch error
        error isa InferenceError || rethrow()
        report!(runner,"type error",error.position,type_error_message(error))
        return
    end
    warnings = check_item!(item,keys(runner.type_environment))
    write_types!(runner,item,inferred,inferencer.local_bindings)
    for (position,priority,message) in warnings
        report!(runner,"warning",position,message)
    end
    environment,values,value = nothing,nothing,nothing
    try
        if item.kind == "declaration"
            environment = evaluate_group!(evaluator,item.value,runner.value_environment)
            values = Any[environment[binding.name] for binding in item.value.bindings]
        else
            value = evaluate!(evaluator,item.value,runner.value_environment)
        end
    catch error
        error isa RuntimeFailure || rethrow()
        report!(runner,"runtime error",error.position,error.message)
        return
    end
    if item.kind == "declaration"
        types = copy(runner.type_environment)
        for (binding,value) in zip(item.value.bindings,values)
            push!(runner.values,binding.name * " = " * print_value(value))
            types[binding.name] = binding.scheme
        end
        runner.type_environment,runner.value_environment = types,environment
        counts["bindings"] += length(item.value.bindings)
    else
        push!(runner.values,"- = " * print_value(value))
    end
end
function process_file!(runner,filename,source)
    runner.current_file = filename
    counts = runner.statistics[filename]
    push!(runner.types,"== $filename ==")
    push!(runner.values,"== $filename ==")
    push!(runner.formatted,"(* $filename *)")
    pending = Dict{String,Tuple{MLToken,MLNode}}()
    evaluator = Evaluator()
    parser = MLParser(tokenize(source,filename))
    while next_token(parser).kind != "EOF"
        counts["items"] += 1
        try
            item = parse_item!(parser)
            process_item!(runner,item,pending,evaluator,counts)
        catch error
            error isa SyntaxFailure || rethrow()
            report!(runner,"syntax error",error.token.position,syntax_error_message(error.token))
            recover!(parser)
        end
    end
    for signature in sort(collect(values(pending));by=s -> s[1].position[2:3])
        unused_signature!(runner,signature)
    end
    counts["calls"] = evaluator.calls
end
function main()
    raw_sources = Dict(filename=>read(joinpath("input",filename),String) for filename in FILE_NAMES)
    sources = Dict(filename=>String.(split(raw_sources[filename],'\n';keepempty=true)[1:end-1]) for filename in FILE_NAMES)
    types,values = built_in_environments()
    statistics = Dict(filename=>Dict(name=>0 for name in COUNTER_NAMES) for filename in FILE_NAMES)
    runner = MLRunner(sources,types,values,"",statistics,String[],String[],String[],String[])
    for filename in FILE_NAMES
        process_file!(runner,filename,raw_sources[filename])
    end
    push!(runner.reports,"== summary ==")
    for filename in FILE_NAMES
        summary = join(["$name=$(runner.statistics[filename][name])" for name in COUNTER_NAMES]," ")
        push!(runner.reports,"$filename: $summary")
    end
    mkpath("output")
    for (filename,lines) in [("types.txt",runner.types),("values.txt",runner.values),("errors.txt",runner.reports),("formatted.ml",runner.formatted)]
        write(joinpath("output",filename),join(lines,"\n") * "\n")
    end
end
main()

Scheme(value) = Scheme(value,Set{TypeVariable}())
const INT = ml_type("int")
const BOOL = ml_type("bool")
const STRING = ml_type("string")
function resolve_type(value)
    path = TypeVariable[]
    while value isa TypeVariable && value.binding !== nothing
        push!(path,value)
        value = value.binding
    end
    for variable in path
        variable.binding = value
    end
    value
end
function occurs(variable,value)
    value = resolve_type(value)
    value isa TypeVariable && return variable === value
    any(child -> occurs(variable,child),value.children)
end
struct UnificationFailure <: Exception
    expected::MLType
    found::MLType
    infinite::Bool
    nested::Bool
end
function unify!(expected,found,nested=false)
    expected,found = resolve_type(expected),resolve_type(found)
    expected === found && return
    if expected isa TypeVariable
        occurs(expected,found) && throw(UnificationFailure(expected,found,true,nested))
        expected.binding = found
    elseif found isa TypeVariable
        occurs(found,expected) && throw(UnificationFailure(expected,found,true,nested))
        found.binding = expected
    else
        expected.kind == found.kind || throw(UnificationFailure(expected,found,false,nested))
        for (first,second) in zip(expected.children,found.children)
            unify!(first,second,true)
        end
    end
end
function free_variables(value)
    value = resolve_type(value)
    value isa TypeVariable && return Set([value])
    variables = Set{TypeVariable}()
    for child in value.children
        union!(variables,free_variables(child))
    end
    variables
end
function generalize(value,environment)
    free_in_environment = Set{TypeVariable}()
    for scheme in values(environment)
        union!(free_in_environment,setdiff(free_variables(scheme.value),scheme.quantified))
    end
    Scheme(value,setdiff(free_variables(value),free_in_environment))
end
function instantiate(scheme)
    replacements = IdDict{TypeVariable,TypeVariable}()
    function copy_type(value)
        value = resolve_type(value)
        if value isa TypeVariable
            value in scheme.quantified || return value
            return get!(() -> TypeVariable(),replacements,value)
        end
        ml_type(value.kind,[copy_type(child) for child in value.children]...)
    end
    copy_type(scheme.value)
end
